source_name: BC Schools - K-12 with Francophone Indicators
coverage: All standard-school records in the current downloaded BC K–12 directory within the map bounds, including accepted official civic-address geocodes for missing coordinates. Current Ministry city-directory grade ranges take precedence over erroneous location-CSV education-level labels. A school with more than one unlisted campus still has one Ministry record. The July 2026 source describes 2025/26 and has no live school open/closed status field. Proximity does not establish school catchment, admission eligibility, capacity or available places.
